name: Koala
effect:
When this Leader attacks your opponent's Leader, if you have 2 or more Characters with a cost of 8 or more, draw 1 card.
[Once Per Turn] This effect can be activated when your opponent plays a Character with a base cost of 8 or more, or when your opponent plays a Character using a Character's effect. Your opponent adds 1 card from the top of their Life cards to their hand.

official_faq.question: Can I activate this [Once Per Turn] effect when my opponent plays a Character using a Character card's [Trigger] effect?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. Playing a Character using a [Trigger] effect is not considered playing it using a Character effect.

official_faq.question: If my opponent plays a Character card with a base cost of 8 or more using a Character's effect, can I use this [Once Per Turn] effect to make them add 2 cards from the top of their Life cards to their hand?
official_faq.answer: No. Your opponent will only add 1 card from their Life cards to their hand.

official_faq.question: My opponent played "OP06-119 Sanji" when they had 0 Life cards, and used its [On Play] effect to play "OP08-069 Charlotte Linlin". Then, after the effect of [Charlotte Linlin] added 1 card from their deck to their Life cards, can I activate this Leader's [Once Per Turn] effect to make them add 1 card from their Life cards to their hand?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. You can choose not to activate the [Once Per Turn] effect of [Koala] when Sanji is played, and then choose to activate it in response to [Charlotte Linlin] being played after your opponent has activated and resolved the [On Play] effect of [Charlotte Linlin].
